text_block_list.text:
I call Нарита Брайан over so I can give her
some fan
mail.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: If that's everything, I'll be on my way.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to read it?

text_block_list.text:
It's my letter. What I do with it is my
business,
right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list:
Promise that you won't just throw it away, at
least!

text_block_list.text:
I'm just not going to read it here. That's
all I
meant.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I'd never throw away a letter from a fan...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан carefully puts the fan letter
in her
pocket, then leaves brusquely.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
